task: Replace the per-push Jev REV gate with REV's deterministic tests gate, with Jev reviewing the contract once per digest.

criteria.description: The per-push Jev evaluation is removed: no CI job sends PR evidence to TypeSafe or references a TypeSafe API key, and the old evidence collector, PR coverage contract, source manifests and their CI step are deleted.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > removes the per-push Jev gate and its evidence collector

criteria.description: The REV job runs aviarytech/rev pinned to a full commit SHA in tests scope, after every other CI job, which are also the contract's required checks. It reads only downloaded artifacts: no checkout, install, run step or secret. It takes the reviewed digest from the PR-specific REV_CONTRACT_PR_<number> repository variable. The rev-tests job checks out the same REV commit.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > runs pinned REV in tests scope after every CI job, from artifacts only, without an API key

criteria.description: The rev-tests job runs the task's named test files twice and writes REV reports: on head sources, and with the head's named test files copied onto merge-base sources. TypeScript tests run under Bun from their package directory, and .mjs/.js tests under Node from the repository root; other files are rejected. A test that fails on base is reported as failed, not as an error.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > runs named tests on head and on merge-base sources with head tests copied in

criteria.description: The REV guide, workflow README and PR template explain writing per-PR criteria with named tests and path globs, collecting the change with tests-change.js, reviewing the contract with review-contract.js and pinning REV_CONTRACT_PR_<number> with --pin. They state that Jev never runs per push.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > documents per-PR criteria, Jev contract review and digest pinning

criteria.description: The PR adds an empty changeset, so no package release is produced.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > adds an empty changeset so no package is released
